title: The Animals Arrive
lesson: When God shuts the door, you are safe inside.
lines: The ark was finished. Then God said to Noah: Come thou and all thy house into the ark.
In seven days, God said, it would rain. Forty days and forty nights. And Noah did all that the Lord commanded him.
And then, they came. Two by two. Elephants. Lions. Giraffes, ducking their very long necks.
Of the clean animals, seven of each kind. Of the others, two: a male and a female.
Noah didn't have to chase a single one. Nobody needed a net. They walked in, just as God had commanded.
Then Noah, his wife, his three sons and their wives went in. And the Lord shut him in.
Noah did not close the door. God did. When God shuts the door, you are safe inside, whatever storm is coming.
Next time: the flood. Follow so you don't miss it!
